# event type

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:eventType`](gmeow-eventType.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/eventType>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/events`](../../slices/events.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The kind(s) of an event, drawn from the open [`gmeow:EventType`](../classes/gmeow-EventType.md) value vocabulary. Non-functional: an occurrence may carry several types (a wedding that is also a religious rite), and competing standpoint-indexed type claims coexist rather than contradict.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Event`](../classes/gmeow-Event.md) -> [`gmeow:EventType`](../classes/gmeow-EventType.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:eventType`](gmeow-eventType.md) from [`gmeow:Event`](../classes/gmeow-Event.md) to [`gmeow:EventType`](../classes/gmeow-EventType.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Example Snippets

These snippets are generated from canonical slice examples and trimmed to the Turtle blocks where this term appears.

### Wedding

- **Source:** [`slices/core/events/examples/wedding.ttl`](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/slices/core/events/examples/wedding.ttl)
- **Examples catalog:** [open in catalog](../../examples/index.md#example-slices-core-events-examples-wedding)#example-slices-core-events-examples-wedding

```turtle
ex:wedding a gmeow:Event ;
    rdfs:label "the marriage of Alex and Sam"@en ;
    gmeow:eventType gmeow:eventTypeMarriage ;
    gmeow:eventTime "2026-06-20T15:00:00Z"^^xsd:dateTime ;
    gmeow:eventTemporalFrame gmeow:temporalFrameUTCGregorian ;
    gmeow:eventLocation ex:chapel ;
    # Flat participation for the witnesses ONLY — no role/period/evidence needed.
    # The principals and the officiant are instead reified below (with roles), so
    # they are deliberately NOT repeated here: flat and reified never overlap.
    gmeow:hasParticipant ex:witnessA , ex:witnessB .
```

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to record what KIND of occurrence an event is, drawing one or more values from [`gmeow:EventType`](../classes/gmeow-EventType.md); assert several when one occurrence is genuinely several kinds at once (a wedding that is also a religious rite).

### Avoid when

- Avoid encoding the kind as an [rdf:type](http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#type) subclass instead ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)), and avoid collapsing competing source type-claims — keep it non-functional so standpoint-indexed types coexist via [`gmeow:accordingTo`](gmeow-accordingTo.md) rather than contradict.

### How to use

- Point the [`gmeow:Event`](../classes/gmeow-Event.md) at one or more [`gmeow:EventType`](../classes/gmeow-EventType.md) individuals; for a disputed kind, carry each claim on its own statement with [`gmeow:accordingTo`](gmeow-accordingTo.md) and [`gmeow:confidence`](gmeow-confidence.md) rather than choosing a primary.

### Examples

- ex:wedding [`gmeow:eventType`](gmeow-eventType.md) [`gmeow:eventTypeMarriage`](../individuals/gmeow-eventTypeMarriage.md), [`gmeow:eventTypeBaptism`](../individuals/gmeow-eventTypeBaptism.md).
